title: Government will not promise net savings in budget update, despite inflation pressure
paragraphs: The finance minister and treasurer have refused to confirm December's budget update will contain more savings than new spending, even as pressure mounts on the federal government to tighten its belt.
Finance Minister Katy Gallagher told ABC Insiders pressures on the budget were growing, and decisions were still being made for the mid-year update.
The mid-year economic and fiscal outlook will be delivered in December.
